items.q: Now, I listen to the Aragon music. So Aragon tried to bend himself to play the different rhythms...

ctx.x: Well, I tell you exactly what _______ is. The _______ is mental, mental, they're jazz-oriented. That's the formation of the group.

And I had a conversation with some of the -- in the middle of the streets. There was too much jazz-oriented. So somebody got into the _______ and said listen, let's get into the Cuban _______. So Valdez -- Chucho and the other Valdez, got no relation to him but a relation to (unintelligible) Valdez. (Unintelligible). We got to do something with the guitar, can sing something, to break the impact. And then we go to the other thing.
